item.title: The Human Brain and the Trap of Religious Dogma 1
item.description: The human brain cannot accept that life is meaningless. In search of meaning, we discover gods and create religion.

item.title: Faith in the Absence of Certainty
item.description: Worship seems to require faith without certainty, a commitment to believe despite many unanswered questions.

item.title: Philosophy of Bad Memories
item.description: Your memories are constantly floating in your brain. They can’t be gone or erased because they’re part of your experience and proofs your existence.

item.title: Observing the Reality 1
item.description: After your death, the only things that will be left in this world are your works and memories.
